name: 新粗野主义波普风
origin: 致敬 Gumroad、Figma 与 neobrutalism-components 潮流——高饱和明快波普色块、3px 纯黑粗描边、零模糊硬边投影（5px 5px 0 #000）以及点击归零贴合的物理反馈。
originEn: Inspired by Gumroad, Figma, and neobrutalism-components — high-saturation pop color blocks, bold 3px solid black strokes, zero-blur 5px hard drop shadows, and crisp snap-to-zero click physics.
bestFor: 创作者变现平台、独立开发者 SaaS 定价页、潮流电商、设计工具官网。
bestForEn: Creator commerce platforms, indie SaaS landing pages, bold e-commerce, design tool portals.
donts: 严禁使用任何带模糊半径的阴影（blur 必须严格为 0px，如 5px 5px 0px #000）
严禁使用浅灰细边框（#E5E7EB）——所有卡片、输入框与按钮必须统一使用 2.5px~3px 纯黑实线描边
严禁使用低对比雾霾灰文字，保持纯黑粗体高张力视觉冲击
dontsEn: NEVER use blurred shadows — shadow blur radius MUST be strictly 0px (e.g. 5px 5px 0px #000000)
NEVER use faint grey 1px borders — enforce 2.5px–3px solid #000000 strokes across all cards, inputs, and buttons
NEVER use washed-out low-contrast text or subtle translucent gradients
prompt:
请采用「新粗野主义（Neo-Brutalism Hard Shadow）」构建此界面：
1. 粗黑描边与零模糊硬阴影：暖白底 #FFFDF7 上排布高饱和色块卡片（明黄 #FFDE59、珊瑚红 #FF6B6B、青柠绿 #A3E635、淡紫 #C4B5FD），所有容器、输入框与按钮统一使用 3px solid #000000 纯黑粗边框 + 5px 5px 0px #000000 零模糊硬阴影。
2. 按压物理反馈：按钮悬停时轻微浮起（translate(-1px,-1px) + 6px 硬阴影），点击 :active 时瞬间向右下方位移 translate(4px,4px) 且阴影归零（0px 0px 0px），模拟贴合底纸的干脆手感。
promptEn:
Build this interface using the "Neo-Brutalism (neobrutalism-components)" aesthetic:
1. Thick Black Strokes & Zero-Blur Shadows: Pair #FFFDF7 canvas with bold pop fills (#FFDE59 yellow, #FF6B6B coral, #A3E635 lime, #C4B5FD lavender). Enforce 3px solid #000000 borders and crisp 5px 5px 0px #000000 hard shadows (0px blur!) on every card, input, and badge.
2. Snap-to-Zero Click Physics: Buttons cast 4px 4px 0px #000000 shadows and snap to translate(4px, 4px) with 0px shadow on :active.

primitive.summary: 3px 纯黑粗描边 + 5px 零模糊硬边阴影卡片与点击位移归零波普按钮
primitive.summaryEn: 3px solid black stroke card with 5px zero-blur hard shadow and snap-on-click pop button
